segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יִרְמְיָה, תָּנֵי: אַף עַל שְׁבוּעַת בִּיטּוּי.
segments.en: «Rabbi Yirmeya said: Teach» the mishna with this emendation: If he did not eat it, he «also» violated the prohibition «against» breaking «an oath on an utterance.»
